text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you leaving already, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll be back soon, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Of course. Good luck…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …And don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't plan to. I'm heading out with the sole intention to win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup. This 2,400-meter, medium-distance turf race is held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Every year, stars from around the globe gather here, and Japan gets swept up in a whirlwind of enthusiasm for this world-class race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But today… just for today… I'm going to make that world mine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A 2,400-meter, medium-distance turf race at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's right… This race is a classic distance, just like a certain other race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow… I've never seen Maruzensky race before!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Boy, you're in for a treat, then! Plus, she's squaring off against Chiyono O from the autumn Tenno Sho. I wonder who'll win?!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: The venue is more crowded than usual today, so please proceed to your seats calmly and without pushing!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: But of course it's crowded. Who could say no to watching a race with such a lineup?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: In one corner is the Umamusume who defeated the Eternal Top Three. In the other, the legendary Umamusume whose return no one expected.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: This will be a race like none other…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …All right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I am. There's nothing to waver about at this point. There's only one thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to reach out and grab victory, and I refuse to let it slip from my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer… I'm the pot, and you're the ladle, remember?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I heard you calling out to me during the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. Your voice gave me the final push I needed toward the end.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why… When I'm out there…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Can you keep pushing me onward when I'm running? With your support, I could run even to the ends of the world.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Once I open these doors, go into the runners' tunnel…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And head toward that bright, bright light at its end…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, Maruzen! How are you feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I feel on the very tippy-top of the world, Chiyo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I apologize in advance, though. My engine's been roaring to go for so long, I'm afraid I won't be able to hold back once we start.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So let the Beast gobble you right up, darling!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I'm not letting that happen. If anyone's doing the devouring around here, it's going to be me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's get out there and enjoy this once-in-a-lifetime moment to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Maruzen
text_block_list.text: Our Derby awaits us.
